how_zh: 对方到家或进门时，在门口或约定的位置跪下。
保持约定的姿势和眼神方向。
对方坐下或说一句话后即可起身，不用等太久。
第一次先约好姿势和时长，别临场猜。
how_en: Kneel where you've agreed — the door, or once they've sat down.
Hold the posture and eye direction you settled on.
It ends when they say so or sit down — thirty seconds is plenty to start.
Agree the position once, ahead of time, so nobody is guessing.

how_zh: 出门前拍一张当天穿着的照片。
连同预计出门时间一起发给对方。
对方看到即可，不要求立刻回复。
路上有变化（换车、晚点）随手补一句。
how_en: Take a photo of what you're wearing before you head out.
Send it along with your planned departure time.
It's enough that they see it — no reply expected right away.
If plans change en route, send a quick update.

how_zh: 到家或到目的地后，发一句简单的到达消息。
不用长篇，一句「到了」加时间就够。
如果晚了，说明原因而不是不说。
how_en: Send a short message once you're home or wherever you were headed.
Keep it simple — 'arrived' plus the time is enough.
If you're late, say why rather than staying quiet.

how_zh: 起床后发一句问候或今天的状态。
睡前再发一句，说说今天怎么样。
对方不用每次都长回，一个表情或简单回应也算数。
固定大致时间，比每天想起来才发更容易坚持。
how_en: Send a short greeting or how-you're-feeling when you wake up.
Send another before bed, a quick note on how the day went.
A short reply or even an emoji from the other side counts.
Pick roughly fixed times — it's easier to keep than remembering ad hoc.

how_zh: 选一件小事：泡咖啡、摆好衣服、放好洗漱用品。
按对方喜欢的方式做，而不是自己觉得方便的方式。
固定下来，每次都做，被注意到才是重点。
how_en: Pick one small thing: coffee, laid-out clothes, a ready bathroom.
Do it the way they like, not the way that's easiest for you.
Keep it consistent — being noticed is the point.

title_en: Inspect, and say what you see
how_zh: 看一下对方完成的任务、房间或穿着。
说出具体看到的一两点，肯定或指出问题都可以。
不需要长篇点评，简短、具体就够。
how_en: Look over a finished task, the room, or how they're dressed.
Name one or two specific things you notice — praise or correction both work.
Keep it short and specific rather than a long review.

how_zh: 早上花一分钟列出今天要做的 2-3 件家务。
发给对方或写在共同能看到的地方。
完成情况晚上简单确认一下。
how_en: Take a minute each morning to list 2-3 chores for the day.
Send them or write them somewhere both of you can see.
Check in briefly in the evening on what got done.

title_en: Three things you want to accomplish today
how_zh: 早上想好三件今天想做到的事，发给对方。
对方可以直接接受，也可以调整顺序或替换一件。
晚上简单说说做到了几件。
how_en: Each morning, think of three things you want to get done and send them.
The other can accept as-is, reorder, or swap one out.
In the evening, note how many you got to.

title_en: Explain when a task can't be done
how_zh: 发现某件事今天做不到时，主动说明情况。
不需要完美的理由，说清楚发生了什么就好。
对方可以决定顺延、免除或换个方式。
how_en: When something can't be done today, say so before it's missed.
It doesn't need to be a perfect excuse — just what actually happened.
The other decides whether to push it, waive it, or adjust it.

how_zh: 发现自己违反了一条规矩，主动说出来，不等对方发现。
简单说明发生了什么、为什么。
接受对方的回应，无论是原谅还是处置。
how_en: When you break a rule, say so before you're caught.
Explain briefly what happened and why.
Accept whatever they decide — mercy or a consequence.

title_en: One thing that needs permission first
how_zh: 挑一件日常小事，约定以后先问过再做。
问的时候说清楚具体是什么、什么时候。
对方给出「可以/不可以/等一下」，事情才算定下来。
how_en: Pick one ordinary thing and agree it gets asked about first.
When asking, be specific about what and when.
The other answers yes, no, or wait — that settles it.

how_zh: 选三条：一条必须做的、一条禁止的、一条需请示的。
写在两人都能看到的地方，措辞尽量具体。
一周后回看，觉得没用的可以改，别急着加更多。
how_en: Pick three: one required, one forbidden, one that needs permission.
Write them somewhere both can see, worded as specifically as you can.
Revisit after a week — edit what isn't working before adding more.

title_zh: 各自说出硬限制和软限制
title_en: Name your hard and soft limits
how_zh: 找一个都不赶时间的时刻坐下来聊。
各自说出几条绝对不做的事（硬限制）。
再各自说出视情况而定的事（软限制）。
都写下来，双方的限制同样重要。
how_en: Sit down at a time when neither of you is rushed.
Each name a few things that are simply off the table.
Then each name a few things that depend on the situation.
Write them down — both people's limits count equally.
needs_zh: 无道具，需要安静的时间

how_zh: 挑一条已经定下一段时间的规矩或限制。
直接问对方：这条现在还合适吗？
改掉不再合适的部分，不算失败，是正常调整。
how_en: Pick one rule or limit that's been standing for a while.
Ask plainly: does this still fit?
Changing it isn't failure — it's normal upkeep.

how_zh: 约定绿色=继续、黄色=先停一下、红色=马上停止。
说好红色之后的十秒钟具体要做什么（松绑、开灯等）。
找个平静的时刻先练习说一次，别等到真正需要时才第一次用。
how_en: Agree green means more, yellow means pause, red means stop now.
Agree what happens in the ten seconds after red — restraints off, lights on.
Practice saying it once while calm, not for the first time when it matters.

how_zh: 每天挑一件对方做到的事。
具体说出来：「你今天先问了我，我看到了」。
比泛泛的「很好」更有分量。
how_en: Each day, pick one specific thing they did.
Name it directly: 'You asked first today, and I noticed.'
It lands harder than a generic 'good job.'

how_zh: 遇到情有可原的违规，明确说「这次我放过」。
说清楚是主动决定放过，不是没注意到。
让对方知道这是被看见、被原谅，而不是没被追究。
how_en: When a broken rule has a real reason behind it, say plainly 'I'm letting this one go.'
Make clear it's a decision, not something you missed.
So they know it was seen and forgiven, not overlooked.

how_zh: 找个平静的时刻，为每条规矩想好对应的后果。
写下来：抄写、罚站、取消特权，或者干脆决定不用惩罚。
真正违规发生时，就不用临时决定，也不会带气发火。
how_en: Pick a calm moment and decide what follows if each rule is broken.
Write it down: lines, corner time, a lost privilege — or decide you won't use punishment at all.
When it's actually needed, it's not a negotiation made in anger.

title_en: Carry it out, then say it's over
how_zh: 说明违反的是哪条规矩。
执行事先谈好的后果。
结束后明确说「这件事过去了」，之后不再提。
how_en: Name which rule was broken.
Carry out the consequence you'd already agreed on.
Afterwards say clearly it's finished — and don't bring it up again.

how_zh: 早上告诉对方今天穿什么，或从清单里选。
说清楚具体到什么程度（颜色、款式）由你们自己定。
如果对方要出门，考虑场合是否合适。
how_en: Tell them what to wear today, or pick from an agreed list.
Decide together how specific this gets — color, style, whatever you choose.
If they're going out, consider whether it fits the setting.

how_zh: 选一件日常可戴的东西：项圈、手环、锁。
约定什么时候戴、什么时候可以摘。
对物件本身的意义，两人私下达成共识就好，不需要外人理解。
how_en: Choose something wearable day-to-day: a collar, bracelet, or lock.
Agree when it's worn and when it can come off.
Its meaning is between the two of you — nobody else needs to understand it.

title_en: A quick water or meal report
how_zh: 吃饭或喝水后发一句简单记录。
不用精确到克，大概就行。
目的是让对方知道你在照顾自己，不是被监视。
how_en: Send a short note after eating or drinking water.
No need to be precise — a rough note is enough.
The point is letting them know you're taking care of yourself, not being watched.

how_zh: 睡前发一条消息，说说今天的完成情况。
没做到的部分老实说，不用美化。
对方回一句肯定或指正即可，不用长谈。
how_en: Send a message before bed on how the day went.
Be honest about what didn't get done — no need to gloss over it.
A short reply from the other side — praise or a note — is enough.

how_zh: 完成一件有点挑战的任务后，花几分钟写下当时的感受。
不用长，几句真实的话就够。
可以选择要不要给对方看。
how_en: After a task that stretched you a little, take a few minutes to write how it felt.
Doesn't need to be long — a few honest lines are enough.
You can choose whether to share it or keep it private.

title_zh: 事前先问需要什么样的事后关怀
title_en: Ask what aftercare they'll need, beforehand
how_zh: 在开始有强度的事情前，先问一句「结束后你想要什么」。
常见答案：安静抱一会、喝水、被夸「你做得很好」。
记住这次的答案，事后照做，别临场现想。
how_en: Before anything intense, ask directly: what will you want afterward?
Common answers: quiet holding, water, hearing 'you did well.'
Remember the answer and follow through — don't improvise in the moment.

title_en: Check in on their state, the next day
how_zh: 强度较高的事情之后一两天，主动问对方感觉如何。
掌权的一方也会有低落或自我怀疑，说出来会好一些。
不需要长谈，一句「你还好吗」就是开始。
how_en: A day or two after something intense, ask how they're doing.
The one holding power can feel low or doubtful too — naming it helps.
It doesn't need to be a long talk. 'Are you okay?' is enough to start.

title_zh: 出差/不在家时暂停相关任务
how_zh: 出发前告诉对方接下来这段时间不在。
把需要你在场的任务暂停，避免累积「做不到」的记录。
换成不需要你在场也能完成的任务，比如汇报或家务。
how_en: Let them know before you leave that you'll be away for a while.
Pause anything that needs you present, so nothing racks up as missed.
Swap in tasks that don't need you there — reporting, chores, and the like.

title_en: Plead for mercy on the calendar
how_zh: 在有困难完成任务的那天留言，说明情况并请求宽限。
老实写，不用把话说得比实际严重或轻松。
由对方决定是否同意，两种结果都要接受。
how_en: On a day something's hard to complete, leave a note explaining and asking for leeway.
Write it honestly — no need to overstate or downplay it.
The other decides — accept either answer.

title_en: Propose a consequence on the calendar
how_zh: 在某天的记录旁留言，写下你打算安排的后果。
让对方提前知道，而不是当面突然宣布。
对方可以回复，如果确实有异议可以再谈。
how_en: Leave a note by that day's record with the consequence you're planning.
Let them see it ahead of time rather than announcing it on the spot.
They can reply — if there's a real objection, talk it through.

title_en: Set up a points reward shop
how_zh: 列 3-5 个对方可以用积分兑换的奖励。
写清楚每个大概需要多少分（或标记「你决定」）。
过一阵子根据实际使用调整，别一次列太多。
how_en: List 3-5 rewards they can redeem with points.
Note roughly how many points each costs (or mark 'you decide').
Adjust after a while based on what actually gets used — don't overload it up front.

how_zh: 直接聊一次：这段关系里要不要用惩罚。
很多关系只靠肯定和奖励推进，也完全可行。
写下这个决定，避免以后临时加惩罚造成混乱。
how_en: Have a direct conversation: will punishment be part of this dynamic at all?
Plenty of dynamics run entirely on praise and reward — that's a real option.
Write the decision down so a punishment doesn't get improvised later.

how_zh: 谈清楚：多久、谁决定解锁、算违规的情形是什么。
写下来，两人都留一份。
任何一方想调整，随时可以重新谈。
how_en: Talk it through: how long, who decides release, what counts as breaking it.
Write it down where both of you can refer to it.
Either person can ask to revisit it at any time.
needs_en: A chastity device, if you use one

title_zh: 着装状态下先谈好这次的内容
how_zh: 开始前坐下来聊：今晚想做什么、不做什么。
谈清楚强度、时长、安全词。
谈完之后再开始，别边做边现场决定边界。
how_en: Sit down before anything starts: what's on for tonight, what isn't.
Cover intensity, duration, and the safeword.
Only start once that's settled — not while figuring out limits mid-scene.

how_zh: 谈清楚具体要求是什么，双方都能接受。
定期（比如每周）由对方简单确认一下。
标准可以随时间调整，不是一成不变的。
how_en: Talk through what the standard actually is, until both are comfortable.
Have the other check in on it periodically — weekly, say.
It can change over time — it isn't fixed forever.
